title: Raw Telemetry Ingestion
summary: Distributed ingestion of 42.4M raw clickstream events across 13 HDFS partitions, recording user interactions across October 2019.
key_transformations: Streamed multi-gigabyte CSV into distributed HDFS block storage
Enforced initial 9-column schema (event_time, event_type, product_id, category_id, category_code, brand, price, user_id, user_session)
Established 128 MB HDFS block replication (replication factor = 3)
limitations: Input data contained unsegregated formatting inconsistencies and zero/negative prices
Network latency overhead during multi-node distributed ingestion
Category and brand strings contained null/missing values in upstream telemetry

title: Distributed Storage & Block Allocation
summary: Distributed block allocation across cluster worker nodes, guaranteeing fault tolerance and data locality for PySpark workers.
key_transformations: Partitioned continuous telemetry stream into 13 balanced distributed splits
Verified checksum integrity across all HDFS block replicas
Co-located compute nodes with storage blocks to minimize network shuffling
limitations: Raw CSV format lacks columnar metadata and predicate pushdown capabilities
Large text parsing overhead during initial Spark RDD execution

title: PySpark Distributed Cleaning & Validation
summary: Distributed filtering of 68,673 non-positive prices and 30,217 unsegregated malformed records, retaining 42,349,874 verified events (99.77% retention).
key_transformations: Filtered out 68,673 records with price <= 0.00
Quarantined 30,217 unsegregated multi-condition removal records
Sanitized ISO 8601 UTC timestamps into native Spark TimestampType
Enforced null-coalescing for missing category_code ('Unknown / Other') and brand ('Unknown')
Sample-based deduplication audit followed by full-table dropDuplicates() pass
limitations: 30,217 records were filtered as an unsegregated cleaning remainder without granular per-rule tags
Missing category strings (31.91%) and brand strings (14.44%) were preserved as explicit categorical tokens rather than imputed

title: Columnar Parquet Transformation
summary: Converted cleaned row-oriented telemetry into highly compressed columnar Parquet format, achieving a 4x reduction in storage footprint.
key_transformations: Transformed row-based RDDs into columnar Parquet structure
Applied Snappy block compression to numeric and categorical columns
Generated dictionary encoding for repetitive event types and category labels
Embedded min/max column statistics for distributed predicate pushdown
limitations: Write operation required full cluster shuffle to re-partition data cleanly
Parquet files require Spark/Arrow readers and cannot be inspected with basic text editors

title: Distributed Aggregation & Feature Engineering
output_target: Precomputed Analytical CSV Summaries + User Feature Vectors
summary: Executed distributed MapReduce group-by rollups to synthesize temporal, category, and brand summaries, plus 11 user-level behavioral metrics for 3,021,435 users.
key_transformations: Synthesized 14 category revenue summaries and 24 hourly activity bins
Engineered 11 user-level features: total events, views, carts, purchases, revenue, sessions, catalog breadth
Applied log1p(x) transformation to right-skewed monetary metrics (skewness reduced from +2.54 to -0.27)
Standardized 11 feature dimensions using StandardScaler to zero mean and unit variance
limitations: User session boundaries rely on telemetry user_session UUID strings without sliding inactivity windows
November 1 boundary covers only partial UTC hours before log cutoff

title: Machine Learning & Visualization Outputs
technology: PySpark MLlib (PCA & KMeans) + Apache ECharts / Three.js
summary: Conducted 7-component PCA dimensionality reduction (95.97% variance retention) and K-Means clustering (K=2, Silhouette 0.81115), quarantining 1 extreme browsing outlier.
key_transformations: Eigen-decomposed 11x11 covariance matrix into 7 principal components
Evaluated 6 K-Means sensitivity trials across K=2 through K=5
Quarantined 1 extreme browsing outlier (7,429 views, 0 purchases) to prevent centroid pull
Inverted PCA coordinates into business-interpretable centroid metrics (Cluster 0 Core vs Cluster 1 Browsers)
Published 25 static research plots and 4 interactive Plotly/ECharts visualizations
limitations: Unsupervised clustering reflects historical descriptive patterns, not future conversion intent
PCA component axes represent linear combinations of features, not physical behavioral laws
